RESEARCH FOLIO / 001COMPILER PLACEMENT

Qwen2.5 · 1.5B · 28 layers · LUT4

A preference is not
a placement proof.

Inspect the compiler’s assignment before making a claim about the hardware.

2,090ANE-assigned operations
79CPU-assigned operations
June 2026 compute plan96.4% / 3.6%
What this establishes

MLComputePlan classified these operations as ANE- or CPU-assigned. The later shipped infer build reports 2,147 ANE / 82 CPU; it is a different build, not a replacement label for this measurement.

Boundary of the claim

Compiler assignment does not establish runtime residency, throughput or end-to-end model quality.

Read the placement record ↗
RESEARCH FOLIO / 002NUMERICAL PARITY

LFM2.5 · Layer slices → Full chain

Every slice passed.
The chain did not.

A useful negative result changes what gets tested next.

SLICESLICESLICE…
16-LAYER CHAINParity gate missed
What was observed

Individual layer slices meet the strict parity gate. The composed 16-layer chain and token logits do not.

Boundary of the claim

Local numerical agreement cannot be promoted into a claim of complete-model correctness.

Read the chain investigation ↗
RESEARCH FOLIO / 003PERFORMANCE

A18 Pro · Decode · Batch sweeps

The limit that
wasn’t the limit.

When the measurements disagree with the explanation, change the explanation.

INITIAL HYPOTHESIS

Bandwidth explains the limit.

LOOK CLOSER

Batch size. Dispatch cost.
The actual execution regime.

The investigation

Batch sweeps and dispatch-floor measurements challenge a simple bandwidth explanation for decode performance.

Boundary of the claim

A performance result belongs to its device, build and execution conditions—not to every model or workload.

The working method / 02

Make the question
inspectable.

Keep the build, the observation and the interpretation separate.

01 Build the actual path +

Start with the program and its compilation path. Native Swift, hand-authored MIL and Apple’s public Core ML toolchain make the boundaries worth examining explicit.

Build stack and methods ↗
02 Account for the work +

Inspect state access, projections, norms and output tails. Separate compiler classification from evidence of runtime execution.

The placement audit ↗
03 Keep the failed test +

Compare numerical results at exposed boundaries. A failed chain, an unexpected tail or an overturned hypothesis belongs in the record alongside the successes.

The parity case study ↗

Independent by design / 03

Build. Experiment.
Understand what’s
underneath.

MacBrains Labs is an independent research notebook on Apple silicon: how programs are compiled, where work is assigned, and what the results can actually support.

Open methods and explicit limits are part of the work, not footnotes to it.
